summary: Distinguish native BH bootstrap and normal synchronization from probe failures
details: The monitor recognizes fresh native balance-history bootstrap progress written after the current container start, avoiding SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE alerts caused solely by its intentionally unopened RPC port. This evidence never grants readiness or bypasses controller gates.
Stale or invalid journals, sealed baselines, post-RPC regressions and runtime failures retain normal health checks. OOM, restart loops and durable incidents remain independently monitored.

Resource probe history distinguishes not_ready from failed and timeout for supported readiness reports, including AssumeUTXO status helpers that exit with code 1 while syncing. Minute summaries preserve separate counts without storing raw RPC payloads.
operator_actions: Use the normal node-kit upgrade procedure to run the updated monitor. Existing resource history is preserved; older failed records are not retroactively reclassified.
Consult the monitor and resource-history handbook pages for native bootstrap freshness limits and probe outcome meanings.
